verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a REST API with endpoints for incorporation, notarization, translation, and tax/trade registration, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are prose documentation dumps for LLMs, not a machine-readable API specification, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.
